title: Every House Grows to Fit the TALLEST 🏠
description:
In this town, a house grows to fit the tallest one living in it. Tall families live in towers. When a tall lodger moves out, the ceiling comes down a hand a night.

Our old house was always a ladder taller than any of us. It sold in the spring, and Mum hasn't laughed since. The new one fits me exactly, until the morning there's a gap over my head.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment TALL if you saw the box move.
